item.title: [Breaking News] DP Supreme Council: "Exceptionally Allowing Song Young-gil and Kim Yong to Run in Party Convention" ([속보] 민주 최고위 “송영길·김용 전대 출마, 예외적 허용”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea's Supreme Council decided to exceptionally allow lawmaker Song Young-gil and Kim Yong, former vice director of the Democratic Research Institute, to run in the August 17 party convention, despite controversy over their eligibility due to not meeting the party fee payment period. (더불어민주당이 최고위원회가 당비 납부 기간을 충족하지 못해 8·17 전당대회 출마 자격 논란이 불거진 송영길 의원과 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장에 대해 예외적으로 출마를 허용하기로 했다.)

Kang Jun-hyun, the senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party, told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly, "The Supreme Council held a vote on whether to apply the exception, and as a result of the vote, it was decided to submit the exception proposal to the Party Affairs Committee." The Party Affairs Committee is scheduled to be held at 3 p.m. today. (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의 뒤 기자들과 만나 “최고위가 예외 적용 여부에 대해 찬반 표결을 했고, 표결 결과 당무위원회에 (예외적용 안건을) 부의하기로 결정했다”고 밝혔다. 당무위는 이날 오후 3시 개최된다.)

The Democratic Party's internal rules grant the right to be elected in party position elections to rights-bearing party members. A rights-bearing member is defined as a person who joined the party at least six months before the effective date of exercising rights and has paid party fees at least six times within the year prior to the effective date. However, the Party Affairs Committee can recognize the right to be elected exceptionally even if these conditions are not met through its resolution. For the Party Affairs Committee to make a decision, the Supreme Council must refer the relevant agenda item to the committee. (민주당 당규는 당직 선거 시 피선거권을 권리당원에게 부여하고 있다. 권리당원은 권리행사 시행일로부터 6개월 이전까지 입당한 권리당원 중 권리행사 시행일 전 1년 이내에 6회 이상 당비를 낸 사람을 말한다. 다만 당무위 의결을 통해 조건을 갖추지 못해도 예외적으로 피선거권을 인정할 수 있다. 당무위 의결을 위해선 최고위에서 관련 안건을 당무위에 넘겨야 한다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Again Goes to Olympic Park with Sign Saying "Let’s Get Hit Once and Go for Impeachment" (장동혁, 또 올공 가서 “한 대씩 맞고 탄핵가자” 손팻말)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, emerged at the "Jamsil Vote Counting Center Blockade Protest" holding a sign that read "Let’s get hit once and go for impeachment," alongside phrases alluding to President Lee Jae-myung’s "golf scandal" and Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek’s "desertion scandal." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 ‘잠실 개표소 봉쇄 시위’에서 이재명 대통령 ‘골프 의혹’과 안규백 국방부 장관 ‘탈영 의혹’을 언급하는 듯한 문구와 함께 “한 대씩 맞고 탄핵가자”는 손팻말을 들고 나왔다.)

On the 16th, at a protest in front of the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul, Representative Jang held a sign saying, "Golf is fun, huh? Desertion is honorable, huh? Let’s get hit once and go for impeachment." Earlier that day, during a Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly, Representative Jang raised suspicions that President Lee had played golf at the time a Navy soldier went missing near the Northern Limit Line (NLL) in the East Sea on the 12th, and mentioned "impeachment." In response, Senior Presidential Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung stated, "It is difficult to verify the president’s private schedule, so there is no particular comment." <<> The phrase "desertion" on Jang’s sign appears to refer to suspicions regarding Minister Ahn Kyu-baek’s alleged desertion during his service as a short-term soldier (defense soldier). The People Power Party has raised suspicions that while serving as a defense soldier in 1983, Ahn unlawfully left his military duties for seven months, was arrested, and detained in military custody for 30 days. The Ministry of National Defense refuted this on the 10th, stating, "The desertion claim is clearly false." The calligraphy on the sign was written in Representative Jang’s distinctive cursive style. <<> Representative Jang also held a sign saying, "Tomorrow (the 17th), you know 'Olympic Park Day,' right? I’ll be waiting there." Earlier that day, at the "Call for Repeal of the 'Gag Law' and Delivery of Signatures for a Special Citizen’s Investigation" event at the National Assembly, he stated, "We promised citizens to designate tomorrow as 'Olympic Park Day,'" urging attendance at the "vote counting center blockade protest." At one point, Representative Jang received a large national flag from a protest attendee and waved it in sync with the crowd shouting, "Invalid election, re-election, same-day voting, manual vote counting." <<> Representative Jang has faced criticism for his so-called "inflammatory politics." On the 15th, at the "June 3 Disenfranchisement Crisis Rally" in front of the Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City Election Commission, he held a sign reading, "Stealing ballot papers is real insurrection! Lee Jae-myung is the insurrection leader!" On the 11th, during the "vote counting center blockade protest," he held a sign saying, "See that, Jae-myung? Hear that? Then you should accept a special citizen’s investigation." On the 7th, he held a sign stating, "Jae-myung, fight me, not a high school student." <<> This has drawn criticism from both ruling and opposition parties. On the 8th, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won pointed out during a National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee plenary session, "No matter how much inflammatory language goes back and forth in politics, at least showing respect for the head of state, the president, should be a principle, shouldn’t it?" People Power Party lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek also noted in a YTN Radio interview on the 15th with "Jang Seong-cheol’s News Myeongdang," "For the leader of a major party to address the president by first name like that, shouldn’t there be consideration for dignity within the party?" <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (장 대표는 16일 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 앞 시위에서 “골프가 재밌지? 탈영이 떳떳해? 한 대씩 맞고 탄핵가자”는 손팻말을 들었다. 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 장 대표는 지난 12일 동해 북방한계선(NLL) 인근에서 근무하던 해군 장병이 실종된 시간에 이 대통령이 골프를 쳤다는 의혹을 제기하며 “탄핵”을 거론했다. 이날 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 “대통령의 비공개 일정 확인은 어렵다. 따라서 특별한 입장은 없다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: 61% Say "Maintain Prosecution's Supplementary Investigative Powers"... Opinion to Abolish Triple [Gallup] (“검찰 보완수사권 유지” 61%…폐지 의견 3배 [갤럽])
item.description:
A poll released on the 17th showed that the opinion to maintain the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers for police oversight is about three times higher than the opinion for complete abolition. (경찰 견제를 위해 검찰 보완수사권을 그대로 둬야 한다는 의견이 ‘전면 폐지’보다 3배가량 높다는 여론조사가 17일 나왔다.)

According to a survey by Gallup Korea conducted from the 14th to the 16th targeting 1,003 people aged 18 and older nationwide (with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, via telephone interviewer interview), 61% responded that 'supplementary investigative powers should be maintained for police oversight.' The opinion that 'they should be completely abolished in line with the principle of separating indictment and investigation' stood at 23%. (한국갤럽이 지난 14∼16일 전국 만 18살 이상 1003명을 대상으로 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 전화조사원 인터뷰)한 결과, ‘경찰 견제를 위해 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다’고 답한 비율이 61%였다. ‘기소·수사 분리 원칙에 따라 전면 폐지해야 한다’는 의견은 23%였다.)

Among supporters of the Democratic Party of Korea (403 people, ±5 percentage points), the opinion to maintain the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers was 46%, while the opinion to abolish them was 39%, showing near parity. Among supporters of the People Power Party, the opinion to maintain was 81%, overwhelmingly surpassing the abolition opinion (8%). Among centrists, the opinion to maintain supplementary investigative powers was 64%, while the opinion to abolish was 23%. (더불어민주당 지지층(403명, ±5%포인트)에서는 검찰 보완수사권 유지론이 46%, 폐지론이 39%로 비등했다. 국민의힘 지지층은 유지론이 81%로, 폐지론(8%)을 압도했다. 중도층에서는 보완수사권 유지론이 64%, 폐지론이 23%였다.)

In a poll last September, when Gallup Korea asked about a prosecution reform plan involving the abolition of the prosecution and the establishment of a public prosecution office and a major crimes investigation office, the results showed 51% in favor and 37% opposed. (지난해 9월 한국갤럽이 검찰청을 폐지하고 공소청·중대범죄수사청을 신설하는 내용의 검찰 개편안에 대한 의견을 물었던 여론조사에서는 찬성 51%, 반대 37%로 조사됐다.)

Gallup Korea explained, "At that time, 82% of Democratic Party supporters were in favor of (the prosecution reform plan), but they do not appear to be as enthusiastic about this abolition of supplementary investigative powers." (한국갤럽은 “당시 민주당 지지층은 (검찰 개편안에) 82%가 찬성했으나, 이번 보완수사권 폐지안에는 그때만큼 적극적이지 않은 것으로 보인다”고 설명했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik: "Let's finalize the 10th constitutional amendment"... Including restrictions on the power to declare martial law (조정식 의장 “10차 개헌 매듭 짓자”…계엄선포권 제한 등 포함)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik stated on the 17th, "I propose to prepare a constitutional amendment based on popular sovereignty by 2027 and finalize the 10th constitutional amendment within the current 22nd National Assembly." He also formally proposed inter-Korean parliamentary talks to the North. (조정식 국회의장은 17일 “2027년에 국민주권 개헌안을 마련하고, 이번 22대 국회 내에 10차 개헌을 매듭지을 것을 제안한다”고 밝혔다. 또, 남북국회회담을 북쪽에 공식 제안했다.)

At the 78th Constitution Day ceremony held in the central hall of the National Assembly building, Speaker Woo said, "Next year, with no nationwide simultaneous elections, is an opportune time for the National Assembly to roll up its sleeves and calmly discuss constitutional revision. It also marks the 40th anniversary of the 1987 Constitution." He added, "We must fulfill the long-delayed historical responsibility through a constitutional amendment that embodies the people's aspirations and the nation's future." (조 의장은 이날 국회의사당 중앙홀에서 열린 제78주년 제헌절 경축식에서 “내년은 전국동시선거가 없어 국회가 팔을 걷어붙이고 차분하게 개헌을 논의할 수 있는 적기이자, 87년 헌법이 40돌을 맞는 해”라며 “국민의 열망과 나라의 미래를 담은 개헌으로 오래 미뤄 온 시대적 책무를 완수해야 한다”고 말했다.)

To this end, Speaker Woo stated, "I will launch an Advisory Committee on Constitutional Amendment directly under the National Assembly Speaker to organize the roadmap and agenda for revision. After consulting with all political parties, I will establish a Special Committee on Constitutional Amendment at an appropriate time to discuss the amendment proposals sequentially." Key contents of the amendment include "incorporating the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement into the preamble of the Constitution, restricting the president's power to declare martial law, which are tasks with a high level of consensus, along with restructuring the power system and reforming election management." He further stated, "Instead of a political bargain-style amendment, I will establish a citizen-participatory digital platform tentatively named 'Everyone's Constitution' so that the sovereign people can become the true masters of constitutional revision." (조 의장을 이를 위해 “국회의장 직속 헌법개정자문위원회를 발족시켜 개헌 로드맵과 의제를 정리하고, 제 정당과 협의해 적절한 시점에 헌법개정특별위원회를 구성해 개헌안을 순차적으로 논의하겠다”고 했다. 개헌안 주요 내용으로는 “5·18 민주화운동 정신의 헌법전문 수록, 대통령 계엄선포권 제한 등 합의 수준이 높은 과제와 권력구조 개편, 선거관리 개혁”을 꼽았다. 이어 “정치적 담판형 개헌이 아니라 주권자가 개헌의 주인이 될 수 있도록 국민참여형 디지털 플랫폼 ‘모두의 헌법'(가칭)을 구축하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Speaker Woo also said, "As the Speaker of the National Assembly of the Republic of Korea, I formally propose to the representative of the North's Supreme People's Assembly the holding of 'Inter-Korean Parliamentary Talks' to break the deadlock in inter-Korean relations." He added, "Let us meet with an open mind—anytime, anywhere, without any preconditions, whether face-to-face or via video conference. I expect the North to respond with bold and positive participation." (조 의장은 또, “저는 대한민국 국회의장으로서 북측 최고인민회의 대표에게 교착된 남북관계의 물꼬를 틀 '남북국회회담' 개최를 공식적으로 제안한다”며 “어떠한 조건 없이 언제 어디서든, 대면이든 화상이든 열린 마음으로 만나자. 북측이 담대한 호응으로 화답해 주길 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter: Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Slightly Drops to 52%… Democratic Party at 40%, People Power Party at 26% [Gallup] (이 대통령 지지율 52% 소폭 하락…민주 40%·국힘 26% [갤럽])
item.description:
A poll released on the 17th showed that positive evaluations of President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs management stand at 52%. (이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정 평가가 52%라는 여론조사 결과가 17일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 14th to the 16th among 1,003 people aged 18 and over nationwide (with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, via telephone interviewer interviews), the positive evaluation of the president's job performance was 52%, while the negative evaluation was 37%. In Gallup's previous announcement (survey conducted from July 7 to 9), the positive rating was 53% and the negative rating was 35%. (한국갤럽이 지난 14∼16일 전국 만 18살 이상 1003명을 대상으로 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 전화조사원 인터뷰)한 결과, 이 대통령 직무수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 52%, 부정 평가는 37%였다. 갤럽의 지난주 발표(7월 7∼9일 조사)에선 긍정 53%, 부정 35%였다.)

The reasons for positive evaluations were diplomacy (21%), economy and livelihoods (19%), and doing well overall (8%). The reasons for negative evaluations were economy, livelihoods, and high exchange rates (16%), real estate policy (11%), and doing poorly overall (7%). The response citing real estate policy as a reason for negative evaluation rose by 5 percentage points in just one week. (긍정 평가 이유는 외교(21%), 경제·민생(19%), 전반적으로 잘한다(8%) 순으로 나타났다. 부정 평가 이유는 경제·민생·고환율(16%), 부동산 정책(11%), 전반적으로 잘못한다(7%) 순이었다. 부동산 정책을 부정 평가 이유로 꼽은 응답은 한 주 만에 5%포인트가 올랐다.)

In terms of party support, the Democratic Party of Korea was at 40% and the People Power Party at 26%. The Fatherland Innovation Party and the Reform Party each recorded 2%, the same as in the previous week's survey, while the Progressive Party and other parties each stood at 1%. Undecided voters accounted for 28%. (정당 지지도는 더불어민주당이 40%, 국민의힘이 26%로 조사됐다. 조국혁신당과 개혁신당은 각각 지난주 조사와 같은 2%였고, 진보당과 그 이외 정당이 각각 1%였다. 무당층은 28%였다.)

For more details, refer to the website of the Central Election Poll Review Committee. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: Park Ji-hyun and Kim Bo-mi Criticize Allowing Song Young-gil and Kim Yong to Run as “Unfair” (박지현·김보미, ‘송영길·김용 출마 허용’에…“불공정” 비판)
item.description:
On the 17th, the Democratic Party of Korea’s Supreme Council passed a motion to exceptionally allow Rep. Song Young-gil and former Deputy Director of the Democratic Research Institute Kim Yong to run in the August 17th National Convention, despite their failure to meet the party fee payment period requirement—a move that sparked controversy over eligibility and drew criticism within the party as “unfair.” The motion was forwarded to the Party Affairs Committee. (17일 더불어민주당 최고위원회가 당비 납부 기간을 충족하지 못해 8·17 전당대회 출마 자격 논란이 불거진 송영길 의원과 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장에 대해 예외적으로 출마를 허용하는 안건 의결해 당무위원회로 넘긴 가운데, 당내에서 ‘불공정’하다는 비판이 제기되고 있다.)

Former Emergency Response Committee Chair Park Ji-hyun posted on Facebook that day, saying, “Four years later, that situation has arrived. What will the Democratic Party do?” She was referring to her own experience in March 2022 when, as the appointed head of the emergency committee, she attempted to run for party leader in the August National Convention but was barred from running due to “insufficient party membership duration.” She reiterated her past remark: “When a similar situation arises in the future, the Park Ji-hyun case may come back to haunt us time and again.” (박지현 전 비상대책위원장은 이날 페이스북에 “4년이 지나 그 상황이 닥쳤습니다. 민주당은 어떻게 할 것입니까?”라는 글을 올렸다. 2022년 3월 비대위원장으로 선임돼 활동하던 자신이 8월 전당대회 당 대표 선거에 나섰다가 ‘입당 기간 미충족’을 이유로 출마하지 못했던 일을 언급한 것이다. 그는 “추후 비슷한 상황이 닥쳤을 때, 박지현 사례가 두고두고 우리의 발목을 잡게 될지도 모른다”는 당시 자신의 발언을 다시 적었다.)

Kim Bo-mi, a former county councilor from Gangjin who is running for party leader in the August 17th National Convention, also issued a statement that day titled, “Is it okay for a young Park Ji-hyun to be denied, but for the 686 Song Young-gil to be allowed? Is this fair?” (8·17 전당대회 당 대표 선거에 도전한 김보미 전 강진군의원도 이날 ‘청년 박지현은 안되고, 686 송영길은 됩니까? 이게 공정입니까?’라는 제목의 성명을 냈다.)

Kim stated, “Four years ago, young Park Ji-hyun was denied even the submission of her candidacy documents because she hadn’t been a party member for six months. Even her request to open a special meeting of the emergency committee and the Party Affairs Committee to discuss an exception was ignored. But now, they’re reinterpreting the rules to create an exception for an unqualified candidate and are opening a Party Affairs Committee meeting to pave the way for them.” (김 전 군의원은 “4년 전 청년 박지현은 입당한 지 6개월이 되지 않았다는 이유로 후보 신청서류 접수조차 거부당했고, 예외조항이 있으니 비대위와 당무위를 열어 논의해 달라는 요구도 묵살당했다”며 “그런데 이번엔 자격 없는 후보를 규정을 다시 해석해 예외를 만들고 당무위를 열어 길을 터주겠다고 한다”고 했다.)

She criticized, “This is no different from going to a job interview and changing the interview criteria to accommodate an unqualified candidate. If the rules are the same but applied differently to different people, that’s not just unfair—it’s the epitome of abnormality.” (이어 “이는 입사 면접을 갔는데, 자격이 안 되는 면접자를 위해 면접 기준을 바꾸겠다고 하는 것과 한 치도 다르지 않다. 규정은 같은데 사람에 따라 적용을 달리한다면, 그것은 불공정을 넘어 비정상의 극치”라고 비판했다.)

She urged, “The Democratic Party applies principles to the youth and privileges to the establishment. That’s why there are no young people in the Democratic Party. The Party Affairs Committee should apply the same standard to this case that it applied to the youth.” (그는 “민주당은 청년에게는 원칙을 적용하고, 기득권에는 특혜를 적용한다. 그게 민주당에 청년이 없는 이유”라며 “당무위는 청년에게 적용했던 잣대를 이번에도 똑같이 적용하라”고 촉구했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)
